config.script:
userId = self.view.custom.security.userId
	assignmentInfo = self.view.custom.assignmentInfo
	
	if assignmentInfo['endDate'] and system.date.isBefore(assignmentInfo['endDate'], assignmentInfo['startDate']):
		system.perspective.print('Invalid date range')
		system.perspective.sendMessage('showFailerToast', 'Invalid date range')
		return

	if assignmentInfo['mode'] == 'crew':
		retVal, msg = system.kanoa.operators.assignCrewToShift(assignmentInfo, userId)
		system.perspective.print("assignCrewToShift() called with %s returned %s %s"%(assignmentInfo, retVal, msg))
		if msg:
			system.perspective.print("assignCrewToShift() failed: %s"%msg)
			system.perspective.sendMessage('showFailerToast', 'assignCrewToShift() failed: %s'%msg)
			return
	else:
		assignmentId, msg = system.kanoa.operators.addOperatorShiftAssignment(assignmentInfo, userId)
		if msg:
			system.perspective.print("addOperatorShiftAssignment() failed: %s"%msg)
			system.perspective.sendMessage('showFailerToast', 'addOperatorShiftAssignment() failed: %s'%msg)
			return		
	
	system.perspective.sendMessage('showSuccessfulToast', 'Crew member has been added')
	self.view.refreshBinding("custom.assignments.data")	
	
	return

userId = self.view.custom.security.userId
	operatorShiftAssignmentId = self.view.custom.assignments.selection.data[0].operatorShiftAssignmentId
	retVal, msg = system.kanoa.operators.deleteOperatorShiftAssignment(operatorShiftAssignmentId, userId)
	if msg:
		system.perspective.print("deleteOperatorShiftAssignment() failed: %s"%msg)
		system.perspective.sendMessage('showFailerToast', 'deleteOperatorShiftAssignment() failed: %s'%msg)
	else:
		system.perspective.sendMessage('showSuccessfulToast', 'Assignment has been deleted')

	self.view.refreshBinding("custom.assignments.data")
	
	return

userId = self.view.custom.security.userId

	if msg:
		system.perspective.print("endOperatorShiftAssignment() failed: %s"%msg)
		system.perspective.sendMessage('showFailerToast', 'endOperatorShiftAssignment() failed: %s'%msg)
	else:
		system.perspective.sendMessage('showSuccessfulToast', 'Assignment has been removed')
